title: Concept: Composer runs the script after every dependency update
description: composer.json declares a `post-update-cmd` script, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a `post-update-cmd` script.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: A script that runs during install or build executes with the developer or CI identity, before any test or review has looked at the code. This rule reads a `post-update-cmd` script.
